purpose: Construct and diagnose the abiotic exposure matrix before any v3 trait coefficients are inspected. No variable is privileged because it appeared in v2.
ecological_scope: primary ecological inference will be native-range only after the versioned taxon/range join; engineering pilots may use a phenotype-blind subset before that join but may not freeze the final representation

time_alignment.primary: long-term monthly climatology matched to the observation month
time_alignment.meaning: climatological reproductive-period exposure, not weather on the photography date and not verified flowering stage
time_alignment.date_requirement: exact observation month from source observation metadata
time_alignment.bounded_alternative: a centred three-month climatological window may be compared only after its rule is frozen without trait outcomes

redundancy_rule.purpose: flag redundant representations; do not automatically discard a biologically direct exposure in favor of a distal proxy
redundancy_rule.within_family_rule: compare direct month-aligned and broad/derived representations within biological exposure families before deciding the final matrix
redundancy_rule.BIO18_vs_GSP: compare BIO18, GSP and BIO12 against observation-month precipitation and each other on the same native-range environment cohort; choose the smallest biologically interpretable representation before trait fitting, never by trait P values
redundancy_rule.temperature_rule: compare observation-month tas/tasmax with BIO1/BIO4 as distinct timing/seasonality representations rather than assuming annual temperature variables are the baseline

representation_rule: Variables are equal at candidate entry. Final inclusion is determined before trait join from biological proximity to the stated capitulum hypothesis, coverage and non-redundancy. A distal context such as NPP is not forced to survive merely to make all candidates numerically symmetric.
trait_join_prohibited_until: full-source taxon concept join is versioned
environment candidate matrix coverage is reported
environment redundancy and collinearity diagnostics are complete
claim_boundary: Environment-only diagnostics select a representation, not an ecological result. No capitulum trait table may be read by this stage.
